issue_context.title: Add feature flag support for placement rules
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

This is a subtask of https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/18030

A feature flag has already been added in https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/21833

We just need to ensure that it is respected correctly prior to code freeze because placement is an experimental feature, not GA.

review_comments: If possible, use sql to enable this flag, same to other places. It may cause racing or so, if you directly manipulate session.
Okay~  Does CI get in trouble now？
